descriptions.active-memory_create: Insert a new active memory record for an agent in the BrainOS system. Active memories track what each AI agent is currently focused on or has recently learned. Optional: select (comma-separated columns to return from the created row). Returns the newly created active_memory row.
descriptions.brain-config_create: Insert a new brain configuration key-value pair into the brain_config table. Brain config stores runtime settings for the BrainOS AI infrastructure (e.g., model preferences, thresholds, feature flags). Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created config row.
descriptions.brain-config_delete: Delete one or more brain_config rows matching the given filter conditions. Optional filters: key (config key name), value (config value), updated_at (timestamp). Destructive — omitting all filters deletes all rows. Use brain-config_list to preview matches before deleting.
descriptions.brain-config_update: Patch one or more brain_config rows matching the given filter conditions. Optional filters: key (config key to match), value (new config value), updated_at (last-modified timestamp). Partial update — only supplied fields are changed. Returns updated rows.
descriptions.brain-email-capture-log_create: Insert a new email capture log entry into brain_email_capture_log. Tracks emails processed by the BrainOS email ingestion pipeline. Optional: select (columns to return from the inserted row). Returns the created log entry.
descriptions.brain-project-status_create: Insert a new project status record into brain_project_status. Used by BrainOS to track the current state of projects managed by AI agents. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the newly created status row.
descriptions.cron-jobs_create: Insert a new cron job definition into the cron_jobs table. Cron jobs schedule recurring tasks in the BrainOS agent infrastructure. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created cron job row with its id and schedule.
descriptions.documents_create: Insert a new document into the documents table. Documents are full-text searchable content chunks (e.g., notes, articles, knowledge base entries) used by BrainOS agents for retrieval. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created document row including its id.
descriptions.executor-briefs_create: Insert a new executor brief into executor_briefs. Executor briefs are structured task instructions delivered to NatureOS executor agents. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created brief row with its id.
descriptions.mcp-activity-logs_create: Insert a new MCP activity log entry into mcp_activity_logs. Activity logs record tool calls, latency, and outcomes for each MCP server interaction in the BrainOS infrastructure. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created log row.
descriptions.mcp-api-keys_create: Insert a new MCP API key record into mcp_api_keys. MCP API keys control authentication for MCP server connections. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created key row including its id.
descriptions.mcp-auth-errors_create: Insert a new MCP authentication error record into mcp_auth_errors. Auth error records track failed authentication attempts per MCP server, used by the mcp blast-radius and mcp reliability analytics commands. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created error row.
descriptions.mcp-oauth-states_create: Insert a new OAuth state token into mcp_oauth_states. OAuth states are temporary tokens used during the MCP server OAuth authorization flow. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created state row.
descriptions.mcp-servers_create: Insert a new MCP server registration into mcp_servers. MCP servers are the AI tool providers (e.g., brain-mcp, sentry-pp) in the BrainOS infrastructure. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created server row including its id and name.
descriptions.mcp-sessions_create: Insert a new MCP session record into mcp_sessions. MCP sessions track active authenticated connections to MCP servers. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created session row.
descriptions.mcp-tools_create: Insert a new MCP tool registration into mcp_tools. MCP tools are the individual callable functions exposed by each MCP server. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created tool row with its id and server association.
descriptions.mcpapikeys_create: Insert a new MCP API key into the mcpapikeys table (alternate key store). Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created row. Prefer mcp-api-keys_create for the primary mcp_api_keys table.
descriptions.mcpsessions_create: Insert a new session record into the mcpsessions table (alternate session store). Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created row. Prefer mcp-sessions_create for the primary mcp_sessions table.
descriptions.natureos-agent-checkpoints_create: Insert a new NatureOS agent checkpoint into natureos_agent_checkpoints. Checkpoints save the mid-run state of a NatureOS agent so it can resume after interruption. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created checkpoint row with its id.
descriptions.natureos-agent-memory_create: Insert a new NatureOS agent memory record into natureos_agent_memory. Agent memories are persistent facts or context items associated with a specific NatureOS agent, distinct from BrainOS active_memory. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created memory row.
descriptions.natureos-allowlist_create: Insert a new email address into the NatureOS allowlist. The allowlist controls which users can access the NatureOS system. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created allowlist row.
descriptions.natureos-allowlist_delete: Delete one or more NatureOS allowlist entries matching the given filters. Optional filters: email (address to remove), created_at (filter by creation timestamp). Destructive — omitting all filters deletes all rows. Use natureos-allowlist_list to preview before deleting.
descriptions.natureos-allowlist_update: Patch one or more NatureOS allowlist entries matching the given filter conditions. Optional fields: email (new address value), created_at (new timestamp). Partial update — only supplied fields are changed. Returns the updated rows.
descriptions.natureos-dual-model-tasks_create: Insert a new dual-model task into natureos_dual_model_tasks. Dual-model tasks are NatureOS jobs that route through two AI models in sequence (e.g., a fast model for triage and a powerful model for execution). Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created task row with its id and goal.
descriptions.natureos-task-queue_create: Insert a new task into the NatureOS task queue. Task queue entries are pending work items for NatureOS agents to pick up and execute. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created task row with its id and priority.
descriptions.rpc_create: Execute the cleanup_agent_memory stored procedure, which removes stale or expired agent memory records from the BrainOS database. No parameters required. Returns the count of deleted rows or a status indicator from the Postgres function.
descriptions.rpc_create-cleanupexpiredcheckpoints: Execute the cleanup_expired_checkpoints stored procedure, which removes NatureOS agent checkpoints past their expiry time. No parameters required. Call periodically to prevent checkpoint table bloat. Returns a status or count from the Postgres function.
descriptions.rpc_create-cleanupexpiredsessions: Execute the cleanup_expired_sessions stored procedure, which removes expired MCP session records from mcp_sessions. No parameters required. Call periodically to keep the sessions table pruned. Returns a status or count from the Postgres function.
descriptions.rpc_create-cleanupoldlogs: Execute the cleanup_old_logs stored procedure, which deletes aged-out MCP activity log entries. No parameters required. Returns a status or row count from the Postgres function. Use the mcp reliability command to check current log volume before running.
descriptions.rpc_create-enqueuetasks: Execute the enqueue_tasks stored procedure, which inserts pending work items into the NatureOS task queue in bulk. No parameters required at the RPC level (task data is passed via request body per the stored procedure's contract). Returns the number of tasks enqueued or their ids.
descriptions.rpc_create-getrunresults: Execute the get_run_results stored procedure, which retrieves the output of a completed NatureOS agent run. No parameters required at the RPC level (run id is passed via request body). Returns the result payload from the Postgres function.
descriptions.rpc_create-isvalidsession: Execute the is_valid_session stored procedure, which checks whether a given MCP session token is still active and unexpired. Pass the session token via the request body. Returns a boolean or status object from the Postgres function.
descriptions.rpc_create-matchthoughts: Execute the match_thoughts stored procedure, which performs semantic vector search over the thoughts table using embeddings. Returns thoughts most similar to the input embedding. Use for agent retrieval tasks where keyword search is insufficient. Prefer the brainos search command for interactive queries.
descriptions.rpc_create-readagentmemory: Execute the read_agent_memory stored procedure, which retrieves the active memory context for a specific NatureOS agent. Pass the agent identifier via request body. Returns the agent's current memory state as a structured object.
descriptions.rpc_create-searchdocuments: Execute the search_documents stored procedure, which performs full-text search across the documents table. Returns matching documents ranked by relevance. Use for hybrid or FTS-only document retrieval from Postgres. Prefer the brainos search command for interactive queries.
descriptions.rpc_create-searchdocumentskeyword: Execute the search_documents_keyword stored procedure, which performs keyword-only (BM25/trgm) search over documents. Returns documents matching the keyword query ranked by text similarity. Use when you want keyword precision without vector embeddings.
descriptions.rpc_create-searchdocumentsvector: Execute the search_documents_vector stored procedure, which performs vector similarity search over the documents table using pgvector embeddings. Returns documents nearest to the input embedding vector. Use for semantic retrieval over stored knowledge base content.
descriptions.rpc_create-searchthoughtshybrid: Execute the search_thoughts_hybrid stored procedure, which combines vector similarity and keyword search over the thoughts table. Returns thoughts most relevant to the input using RRF or hybrid scoring. Use for the best balance of precision and recall in thought retrieval.
descriptions.rpc_create-showlimit: Execute the show_limit stored procedure (POST variant), which returns the current Postgres max connections or query-level limits configured for the BrainOS Supabase project. No parameters. Returns a numeric limit value from the database function.
descriptions.rpc_create-showtrgm: Execute the show_trgm stored procedure (POST variant), which returns the current pg_trgm similarity threshold used for trigram text search in the BrainOS database. No parameters. Returns the numeric threshold value.
descriptions.rpc_create-upsertagentmemory: Execute the upsert_agent_memory stored procedure, which inserts or updates a memory record for a specific NatureOS agent. Pass agent id and memory payload via request body. Returns the resulting memory row after upsert.
descriptions.rpc_create-upsertcheckpoint: Execute the upsert_checkpoint stored procedure, which saves or updates a NatureOS agent checkpoint in natureos_agent_checkpoints. Pass the checkpoint payload via request body. Returns the resulting checkpoint row after upsert.
descriptions.rpc_list-showlimit: Call the show_limit stored procedure via GET, returning the Postgres connection limit configured for the BrainOS Supabase project. No parameters. Returns a numeric value. Equivalent to the POST variant rpc_create-showlimit but uses GET semantics.
descriptions.rpc_list-showtrgm: Call the show_trgm stored procedure via GET, returning the pg_trgm trigram similarity threshold currently in effect for text search in the BrainOS database. No parameters. Returns the numeric threshold value.
descriptions.shared-state_create: Insert a new shared state record into shared_state. Shared state entries are key-value blobs that NatureOS agents read and write for coordination and handoffs between agent runs. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created row with its id and key.
descriptions.skills_create: Insert a new skill record into the skills table. Skills represent capabilities or learned behaviors tracked by the BrainOS skills gap analysis system. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created skill row with its id and domain.
descriptions.thoughts_create: Insert a new thought into the thoughts table. Thoughts are the primary knowledge capture unit in BrainOS — text content with optional embeddings, tags, and source attribution. Used by brain-mcp's capture_thought tool. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created thought row including its id and created_at.
descriptions.webauthn-credentials_create: Insert a new WebAuthn credential into webauthn_credentials. WebAuthn credentials are passkey registrations used for passwordless authentication to the BrainOS system. Optional: select (columns to return). Returns the created credential row with its id.
